name: flow-group-dashboard
description: Flow Group AB advertising dashboard — React + Express + Drizzle + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
